author: "Jack Liu"
format: html

```{r}
# Importing Libraries
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)

# Importing csv file as breeding_site_locations
breeding_site_locations = read_csv("data/breeding_site_locations.csv")
gt(breeding_site_locations)

# Get Column Names
colnames(breeding_site_locations)

# the help function in R for any parameters & uses of a method
help(colnames)    # or simpler: ?colnames

# the equivalent to the python breeding_site_locations.head(), generate the head lines
glimpse(breeding_site_locations)

# return the number of columns / rows of a var
print(nrow(breeding_site_locations))
print(NROW(breeding_site_locations))
print(nrow(1))
print(NROW(1))

# return the dimension of a var
dims = dim(breeding_site_locations)
print(paste(dims[1], dims[2]))    # remember that R starts at 1 !!!

#-------------------------------------------------------------

migratory_connectivity = read_csv("data/migratory_connectivity_dataset.csv")
gt(head(migratory_connectivity))
glimpse(migratory_connectivity)

colnames(migratory_connectivity)


# generating a vector: 
my_nums <- c(2, 4, 6, 8)
sum(my_nums)

# IMPORTANT (interesting!): "|>" pipe symbol can pass the value on the left to the function on the right
my_nums |> sum()
print(my_nums |> sum() |> sqrt() |> round()) # easier for applying a series of function


# Data Filtering
bird_breeding_selected = breeding_site_locations |> select(Site, Longitude, Latitude) |> distinct()    # Filtering Columns & Prevent Duplicates
gt(bird_breeding_selected)

bird_breeding_selected = bird_breeding_selected |> rename(Breeding_Longitude = Longitude, Breeding_Latitude = Latitude)    # rename
gt(bird_breeding_selected)


# Data Filtering for the second df
bird_migration_selected = migratory_connectivity |> select(Site, winterLongitude, winterLatitude, pslon, pslat, iblon, iblat, awestlon, awestlat) |> distinct() |> rename(Winter_Longitude = winterLongitude, Winter_Latitude = winterLatitude, Stopover_Longitude = pslon, Stopover_Latitude = pslat, Iberian_Longitude = iblon, Iberian_Latitude = iblat, Westmost_Longitude=awestlon, Westmost_Latitude=awestlat)

gt(bird_migration_selected)


# Round
round(3.123, digits=1)

x = 1/3      # 0.333333
y = 1-2/3    # 1-0.666666 = 0.333334
print(x == y)  # Thus not equal due to precision issues


# Filtering row: filter(condition)
bird_breeding_dartmoor <- bird_breeding_selected |> filter(Site == "Dartmoor")
gt(bird_breeding_dartmoor)

bird_breeding_long10 <- bird_breeding_selected |> filter(Breeding_Longitude > 10)
gt(bird_breeding_long10)



bird_breeding_exc <- bird_breeding_selected |> filter(Site != "Spain")
bird_migration_exc <- bird_migration_selected |> filter(Site != "Spain")
gt(bird_breeding_exc)
gt(bird_migration_exc)

# ---------------- Part 2 Starts Below ----------------------

bird_migration_grouped <- bird_migration_exc |> group_by(Site)
glimpse(bird_migration_grouped)


lat_df <- bird_migration_grouped |> summarise(Highest_Lat_Stopover = max(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE))
gt(lat_df)

lat_df <- bird_migration_grouped |> summarise(
  Highest_Lat_Stopover = max(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
  Lowest_Lat_Stopover = min(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
  Mean_Lat_Stopover = mean(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
  Highest_Lat_Winter = max(Winter_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
  Lowest_Lat_Winter = min(Winter_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
  Mean_Lat_Winter = mean(Winter_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE)
)
gt(lat_df)



bird_migration_summary <- bird_migration_grouped |> summarise(
  Stopover_Latitude = median(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE), 
  Stopover_Longitude = median(Stopover_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE), 
  Iberian_Latitude = median(Iberian_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE), 
  Iberian_Longitude = median(Iberian_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE), 
  Westmost_Latitude = median(Westmost_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE), 
  Westmost_Longitude = median(Westmost_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE), 
  Winter_Latitude = median(Winter_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE), 
  Winter_Longitude = median(Winter_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE), 
)
gt(bird_migration_summary)



# Joining DataFrames
df_dept <- read_csv("data/depts.csv")
df_score <- read_csv("data/scores.csv")
gt(df_dept)
gt(df_score)

# Full Join retains all possible rows from both df, adding NA for no data
full_join_example <- full_join(df_dept, df_score)
gt(full_join_example)

# Inner Join only retains rows where both df have data
inner_join_example <- inner_join(df_dept, df_score)
gt(inner_join_example)


# Left Join retains all rows in df1, and adds data from df2 (if df1 lines have same idx of df2 lines, add df2 data, otherwise add NA to df2 lines)
left_join_example <- left_join(df_dept, df_score)
gt(left_join_example)

# Right Join retails all rows in df2, and adds data from df1
# [code ignored]




combined_bird_data <- full_join(bird_breeding_exc, bird_migration_summary)
gt(combined_bird_data)

combined_bird_piv <- combined_bird_data |> pivot_longer(
  cols = ends_with(c("_Longitude", "_Latitude")), 
  names_sep = "_", 
  names_to = c("Location_Type", ".value")
)
gt(combined_bird_piv)



gt(df_dept)

keep_depts <- c("Maths", "English")
df_eng_maths <- df_dept |>
  filter(Department %in% keep_depts)

gt(df_eng_maths)




spring_vals <- c("Breeding", "Stopover", "Winter")
spring_data <- combined_bird_piv |>
  filter(Location_Type %in% spring_vals)

autumn_vals <- c("Breeding", "Iberian", "Westmost", "Winter")
autumn_data <- combined_bird_piv |>
  filter(Location_Type %in% autumn_vals)

write_csv(spring_data, "output/birds_spring.csv")
write_csv(autumn_data, "output/birds_autumn.csv")

```
